content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Gather community-team updates for the Net Rights Coalition."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Maintain unit monitoring and stakeholder dashboards, update them every Friday and flag critical issues for immediate response."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Maintain accurate partner/stakeholder contacts and interaction histories, with quarterly verified-contact updates and database-quality reviews."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Draft, format and proofread partnership agreements, concept notes and memoranda of understanding for senior-staff review within three working days of request."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Coordinate partner meetings, agendas, minutes and action follow-up with the P&E Officer, meeting the stated 24-hour scheduling/minutes target."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Conduct preliminary research on prospective partners, institutions and donors relevant to PIN's digital-rights and inclusion work."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Keep unit folders updated for accessible sharing."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Assist with research for digital-advocacy briefs."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Provide planning, logistical and administrative support for PIN engagements, particularly the Digital Rights and Inclusion Forum and other events."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Coordinate event invitations, RSVPs, venue bookings, travel and materials; send invitations three weeks ahead, confirm logistics one week ahead and process travel seven working days before events."},{"requirement_id":"R11","evidence":"Support PIN's participation at external conferences and workshops through registrations and logistical arrangements."},{"requirement_id":"R12","evidence":"Compile data and documentation for partnership and engagement reports."},{"requirement_id":"R13","evidence":"File, scan and archive partnership and engagement records, agreements and reports, filing partnership records within 48 hours of execution."},{"requirement_id":"R14","evidence":"Distribute publications and research outputs to partners and stakeholders within two working days."},{"requirement_id":"R15","evidence":"Maintain shared unit calendars daily and coordinate team schedules."},{"requirement_id":"R16","evidence":"Process partnership invoices within five working days and coordinate payment schedules with finance."},{"requirement_id":"R17","evidence":"Maintain completion/deadline logs, meet weekly assigned deadlines, participate in weekly P&E Officer check-ins, submit accurate weekly timesheets and promptly update Smartsheet."}]}
